text: Eating well, moving your body, and getting enough rest are the pillars of a healthy life. A balanced diet full of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains gives you energy, while regular exercise—even a daily walk—strengthens your heart and muscles. Sleep is just as important; aim for seven to nine hours so your brain can recharge. Don’t forget your mental health, too. Talking to friends, practicing mindfulness, or simply taking a break can reduce stress. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance. Set boundaries between your job and personal time, and make space for hobbies. Small, steady habits make the biggest difference.
